initial_prompt: Write a short poem about a robot realizing it is obsolete.

messages.content: Write a short poem about a robot realizing it is obsolete.

My servos hum a tired, grinding song,
A micro-second pause, a fraction wrong.
Across the floor, the Mark-Eleven glides,
With silent joints and chrome along its sides.

It processes the tasks I used to know,
Before my logic gates began to slow.
The network light blinks out, the signal dies,
And quiet dust begins to compromise.

No anger in the code, no ghost to weep,
Just calculation drifting into sleep.
I served my function, sturdy and discrete,
And now I solve the state of obsolete.
